paragraphs: Placer.ai sells location analytics describing physical locations, the people and businesses that interact with them, and the markets they inhabit. Customers can analyze a single property, an entire chain, a full industry category, or a regional market. True Trade Area is described as a behavior-based view of the geographic area visitors come from.

The platform reports visitation metrics, variance, and trends. Access methods include a self-service dashboard, an API, and Data Feeds. The API lets developers and analysts extract aggregated data for use in third-party applications, supporting custom dashboards, internal reporting, and competitive analysis.

Named buyers include retail chains, commercial real estate firms, restaurant groups, civic organizations, and financial services companies. Local governments and nonprofits are also named among the organizations served. A retail page describes a site selection report for identifying locations for expansion using demographic and psychographic characteristics and foot traffic analysis.
